scope: Native uploads in actual GitLab CE 19.5.3; full products remain the standard, not a completed-product claim

browser.visualReview: Native editor and actual GitLab reader visibly retain original/new decoded PNGs, the file link, table, tasks, math, source-backed references and authored text. The oversized file remains removable/retryable and blocks Save. Reader Read more folding remains GitLab behavior. Final screenshots reviewed after the run.
browser.scopeLimit: Actual image clipboard/picker/save acceptance is Chromium-only; no OS file-drop or full product certification

repairs: Image-only rich fragments land in the target paragraph after the final inline atom, not in the preceding paragraph
Rich insertion into a non-first formatted text fragment includes its actual sibling index
Rich insertion returns host transaction-filter refusal
Generated trailing caret anchors stay unformatted in serialized source; immediate typing keeps its captured format
Local history restores optional typing marks as well as document/selection; independent snapshot rebasing retains those marks
Ordered async insertion captures selection and typing marks before upload, follows unrelated native maps and refuses overlapping changes
Failed file jobs block serialization and host change publication until an explicit retry/removal; removal republishes the intact current draft

attachmentBoundary.source: Authoritative Markdown returned by the actual Rails upload endpoint
attachmentBoundary.lifecycle: File handles are bounded and outside document/history, released on success/cancel/dispose; completed upload Markdown is reused on conversion retry; aborted late results are ignored
attachmentBoundary.retentionLimits: Failed tasks currently live while the editor service stays open. Uploaded binaries can outlive undo/cancel; navigation recovery and server orphan cleanup remain host policies.

size.unchanged: Every individual entry, ESM, CSS, latency, heap/retention and semantic expectation

explanations: Image visibility exposed the wrong insertion caret; the final regression asserts placement/undo/redo and actual decoded upload visibility
Firefox discards constructor ClipboardEvent data; the event-authored fixture now explicitly supplies its transfer and is not claimed as OS clipboard coverage
The 100 MiB isolated upload limit exceeded the audit allocation guard; the bounded 10 MiB setting is changed/restored through the real admin API
GitLab trims the seed final newline during creation; unchanged-save checks now compare its exact actual server record
A direct-save assertion read the record before asynchronous save completion; it now waits for the actual form-to-reader transition
Source inspection exposed empty formatted caret carriers. Cleanup exposed missing typing marks on redo and async target restoration; final focused/native checks cover these repairs
